visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts in a dimly lit living room where a young boy in a white t-shirt and blue shorts is sitting on a large grey sofa, holding a green and yellow toy. The camera pans right to show a large television screen displaying a woman in a fashion-themed video against a green background. (2) The scene cuts to a bright indoor room where a man with glasses and a black Under Armour t-shirt is sitting at a computer desk. He is laughing heartily while looking at a smartphone, surrounded by multiple monitors, a microphone, and drinks. (3) A woman with reddish-brown hair appears alongside the man; they are seen in a medium close-up, smiling and interacting closely in what looks like a home office environment. (4) The setting changes to a bright, modern clothing store with rows of white racks. The man is shown browsing through various garments, holding a brown sweater and his phone to compare items. (5) In a series of cuts, the man selects a light blue off-shoulder top. The woman then emerges from a white fitting room wearing the top with a long white mermaid skirt, posing and gesturing to the camera. (6) The man continues his selection, picking a beige suede jacket and matching skirt, then a white t-shirt with a heart logo. The woman showcases this second outfit, posing playfully in front of a white wall. (7) A third outfit reveal features the woman in a patterned sweater, a black leather jacket, and a black leather mini-skirt with high black boots. She poses confidently in the store aisle. (8) The final segment shows the woman outside the store named 'SEOUL MATE' on a grey-tiled walkway, then inside showing promotional signs and various clothing racks while speaking directly to the viewers.

The BGM switches to a more rhythmic, comedic track with a strong synth beat. The man speaks with a friendly, teasing tone. (3) A 'pop' SFX occurs as the woman's voice joins in. The man's voice remains dominant, articulating his choices of clothing over the continuous electronic BGM. (5) A 'click' sound is heard as clothes are moved on racks. The woman speaks with a casual, happy tone. The music maintains a steady tempo with consistent electronic drum patterns. (6) A 'ding' SFX punctuates the first outfit reveal. The woman's voice increases in pitch and arousal. The BGM swells slightly in volume during the visual transitions, matching the rapid editing rhythm. (7) A 'whoosh' SFX accompanies the second reveal. The man's voice is heard in the background laughing. The woman explains the outfit details with clear articulation and an engaging narrative tone. (8) A 'ding' SFX triggers the third reveal. The woman's voice takes on a more confident tone to match the edgy leather outfit. The BGM continues with high beat strength and no pauses. (9) A final series of 'pop' and 'ding' SFX occur during the promotional segment. The woman's speech rate increases as she delivers the call to action, ending with a clean fade-out.
